text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, of course I know that orchestra! It 
would not be an exaggeration to call them 
the virtuosos I revere the most.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wonderful! Then, will you accept this 
birthday present from the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You chose that orchestra's musica as a 
celebration for me? ...Bravissimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The more classic records you have, the 
richer your life becomes! Thank you so 
much for the wonderful gift!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. It's not a CD, but a concert—right 
after this today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We decided to entrust the "Earth-san 
Birthday Concert" to that orchestra.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but still, you'd want something 
tangible to remember it by, right! I'll 
arrange for a signed CD of the performance 
later!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've also arranged a space where you can 
chat with the orchestra members, so please 
enjoy conversing with them to your heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, ah... Mamma mia... Am I 
dreaming...?
